sar.narrative: Customer C01909 used card C01909‑K2 to make an online purchase of $99.98 on 2016‑11‑01 at 18:12:08, billed to region 299.0. The transaction was initiated from a new iOS device (iOS 11.2.6, mobile Safari generic, 1334×750) that was flagged as a transparent proxy and had no prior history with this account. The device profile is listed among 226 customer profiles that have been associated with 12 confirmed fraud cases and a high fraud incidence rate across the bank. The alert identified a coordinated pattern of card‑not‑present activity involving the same device type and proxy use across multiple customers, linking C01909 to cards C00450‑K1, C01909‑K1, C02780‑K2, C03266‑K1, C06224‑K1, C06224‑K2, C08557‑K1 and C10835‑K2. Prior cases CC‑2774 and CC‑2548 showed a 47 % fraud rate after correction for similar new‑device, proxy‑based alerts, reinforcing the risk assessment. The corrected fraud likelihood for this alert was 0.15, well above the baseline, and the customer has denied authorizing the purchase. These facts collectively indicate that the transaction is suspicious and likely part of a coordinated card‑not‑present fraud scheme.
